answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. The result is a self-purifying economy: every epoch, low-cost fake identities are filtered out by the same reputation mechanics that reward the honest ones.. The effect holds because jury selection is secret and random, so an attacker can never target the specific identities that will judge it. Consider a horizon as the anchor of the cost. A signal stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a haven hold...
